title: Speaking – Test 4
p1: Which day of the week do you like the most? (Why?)
What did you do yesterday evening/last weekend?

Tell us about the people you live with.
What kind of websites do you like? (Why?)

What kind of films do you like?
What’s your favourite type of music? (Why?)

p3.title: The environment
task: A young man would like to do something to help the environment.
Here are some things he could do.
Talk together about the different things he could do to help the environment and say which would be best.

p4: Did you learn about protecting the environment at school? (Why?/Why not?)
Do you ever ride a bicycle? (Why?/Why not?)
Do you like being in places with lots of trees? (Why?/Why not?)
Would you like to recycle more things? (Why?/Why not?)
Do you think people do enough to protect the environment? (Why?/Why not?)
